base: Value of the decedent's personal estate, plus separately the income collected by the personal representative (KRS 395.150(1)); real estate is not in the base.

schedules.text: Not more than 5% of the value of the personal estate plus 5% of income collected (KRS 395.150(1)).
schedules.capNote: Maximum; extra fair and reasonable compensation may be allowed for extraordinary services (KRS 395.150(2)).

testCases.source: computed by hand: 5% x 300,000 personal estate (income would add 5% of income)
